svg.text: Security architecture — layered, zero-trust, HIPAA + PDPA aligned

g.text: • CloudFront + AWS WAF (OWASP Top 10, bot control, rate limits, managed IP reputation)
• API Gateway TLS 1.3 only · Cognito JWT authorizer · per-tenant API keys + usage plans
• Site-to-Site IPsec VPN (IKEv2 · AES-256-GCM · SHA-2 · PFS group 20) dual-tunnel HA for EHR / SharePoint / Admin portal
• No Outposts / Direct Connect · no public ingress to Lambda · all outbound via NAT with allow-list (WHO / PubMed / Graph / FHIR endpoints)
• Clinicians: Cognito user pool per tenant federated via SAML/OIDC to hospital IdP
• Nova staff: IAM Identity Center federated to Nova EntraID · permission sets per env
• MFA mandatory (hospital IdP side) · session lifetime ≤ 8 h
• RBAC: attending · resident · pharmacist · radiologist · auditor · admin
• ABAC: `tenant_id` + `department` IAM session tags on every Bedrock / S3 / OpenSearch call
• Break-glass: separate IAM role · MFA + SNS alert + 30-day access review
• Secrets Manager + automatic rotation · KMS CMK per secret · no env-var secrets
• No long-lived access keys; short STS tokens only · SCPs block root use
• SCIM provisioning from EntraID → Cognito for joiner/mover/leaver
• Bedrock Agent alias per tenant · KMS key policy scoped to tenant account boundary
• Customer-managed KMS CMK per data class (audit · clinical · config)
• S3 Object Lock (Compliance mode) · 6-year retention on audit bucket
• OpenSearch Serverless + DynamoDB + ElastiCache all KMS-encrypted at rest
• TLS 1.3 in transit everywhere · VPC endpoints for Bedrock / S3 / OpenSearch
• Comprehend Medical DetectPHI on every inbound message → reversible tokenization
• Model never sees raw PHI; detokenize only inside tenant VPC response path
• Macie weekly scan on /raw/ · quarantine on PHI classification drift
• GuardDuty Malware Protection for S3 on every putObject
• DLP: outbound Lambda uses Macie + regex scanner to block MRN / SSN / passport leakage
• Backup Vault with KMS + Vault Lock · immutable tier · cross-account replication
• Bedrock Guardrails: denied topics (self-diagnosis without clinician, dosing override, illegal synthesis)
• PHI filter on input + output · prompt-injection filter · contextual grounding ≥ 0.7
• Fixed system prefix · `temperature=0.1` emergency, `0.2` complex · citation required
• Tool allow-list per agent · read-only FHIR scopes · outbound SSRF defense on Lambdas
• Red-team 200+ adversarial prompts pre-launch · re-run after any guardrail incident
• Model provenance: custom model ID pinned · training data hash recorded in catalog
• Canary deployment on every model/prompt change · 5% traffic · 72 h hold · auto-rollback on SLO breach
• Hallucination regression suite runs in CI against holdout questions
• Model card + data statement published per version · review gate signed by clinical lead
• CloudTrail (management + data events) → S3 Object Lock WORM 6 years → Security Lake
• chat_trace DynamoDB: session · query · retrieved chunks · model · tokens · ms · grounded flag
• VPC Flow Logs · GuardDuty · Security Hub (CIS + AWS FSBP + HIPAA conformance pack)
• CloudWatch metrics → SNS: guardrail block rate, citation-fail rate, p95 per lane
• Per-tenant SIEM export via cross-account S3 role (Splunk / Sentinel / QRadar)
• Non-repudiation: every answer signed with KMS + hashed into chat_trace
• Break-glass and PHI-detokenize events emit CloudTrail + SNS to compliance inbox
• Quarterly access review · yearly pen-test · continuous compliance via Audit Manager
• Threat model (STRIDE + MITRE ATLAS) reviewed every release
